[b][u]The Talara[/u][/b]

The Talara cut its course steadily through the Shamat-Argos straight in the dead of night. On the lower deck sat hundreds of containers, of which 50 refrigerated containers were special. Each of the 50 looked the same: blue paint, standard dimensions, barcodes crisp and easily visible. Nothing out of the ordinary.

To the crew, it was just another industrial shipment to Tirakan's growing industrial sector. "Water treatment systems", according to the manifest. The cargo, as boring to the crew as the empty sea, attracted little attention from anyone. No one questioned it.

The bosun made his rounds and sweeped a flashlight across the cargo. Making sure everything was fine before moving on, disinterested. The crew had noticed the heavy locking mechanism and extra seals on the cargo but paid it no attention or chalked it up to a vigilant manufacturer. It wouldn't be the first time they've seen a manufacturer be particularly interested in security.

The containers groaned with the ship as it traversed the waves, the sea splashing against them every now and then, and the crew passing their time in another uneventful voyage.

They had been completely duped about what they were carrying. Inside each of the 50 containers was a piece of state-of-the-art machinery covered in shock-absorbent foam and material. 96K6-SM surface-to-air missile systems, colloquially known as the Pantsir. The most advanced short-range SAM system in the world and deadly for any aircraft or drone that gets within its 40km engagement envelope. 40 launchers, two command posts, six maintenance vehicles, and two mobile power stations, all bound for Tirakan's military.

The Dhora port authorities had waved the shipment through, as they were instructed to. Every document was stamped and prepared to present the shipment as completely legal, above board, and very uninteresting.

The bureaucratic mechanisms had done their job, the crew knew and suspected nothing. It would be a very typical and boring trip to Tirakan.

[nation]Tirakan[/nation]

[sub]Grand Federation of Sikirsk[/sub]]

There has always been discussions about Sikirsk's borders. Inside the middle-Jabritsa federal sector, the borders are... lets say... a bit cranky. After recent discussions, the federal government has announced it shall expand south in order to fix this issue and to smoothen everythin' abit up. This shall also greatly increase effectiveness of border security and other topics. 

[b]History.[/b]

Officially, Sikirsk recognizes the area as South-Ovamvo, the northern half is currently already under Sikirskian rule. And the area has already been owned by Sikirskian-cultured warlords, city-states, and tribes, during history. The area consists of a large Sikirskian minority. Therefore its important we help these people are reintegrate them into the Federation. The population has grown alot recently. Especially because of our humanitarian help in the area starting from 1976. Its only reasonable for them to join the nation.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has decided the area will become under one, united federated state, under its known name of Ovamvo. 

[b]Anything else?[/b]

There has been one single problem. The southern most parts of Ovamvo have been under a trade family for centuries, and they've already openly declared they will use hostility if Sikirsk enters "their" territory. We cant leave our peoples alone, so we must counter their "forces". Law enforcement, with support from smaller-scale armored units and military police, will arrest the wrongdoers. Dismantle any weaponry stashes they have. And allow peace to thrive in the region. Combat regulations shall be lowered, as we do not expect the group to use conventional war tactics. 

[i]With this, we are ready to go.[/i]

[b][i]NEWS REPORT; Special Broadcast[/i][/b]

Good morning, citizens. Welcome to this special broadcast. The Federation is entering a new phase of activity as confirmed earlier today by Marshal-President Volodymyr Uladzimir. A special military police operation has been authorized in the South-Ovamvo region. According to official statements, the operation is aimed at restoring order in an area that has seen a prolonged absence of effective governance. Military police units have been deployed to secure key transport routes, protect civilian infrastructure, and support the establishment of temporary military-administrative control. Federation authorities emphasize that the operation is limited in scope and focused on stabilization rather than combat. Civilian safety, continuity of essential services, and the integration of the region into existing economic and infrastructure networks have been identified as first priorities. Further updates will be provided as the situation develops. 

(A foto of the area is shown) ( https://ibb.co/KccgKjVV )

[i][b]A couple weeks later....[/b][/i]

With the region secured and major routes under control, our attention will shift to development. Federal survey teams have already moved into South-Ovamvo to monitor and note regional land use, population centers, and existing infrastructure. Temporary checkpoints were replaced with permanent administrative offices, and civilian agency groups have began coordinated operations alongside Sikirskian military police. Not to forget, we shall also establish the Ovamvo Federal Planning Group, integrating and welcoming the area with its fellow comrade up north. Damaged highways and large routes would be the first priority. While also laying new roads and other infrastructure to connect it all to the wider Sikirskian network. Power lines were extended southward, bringing consistent electricity to areas that had relied on generators or irregular supply for many decades.

Said surveys have identified fertile agricultural zones and coastal trade points suitable for development, we actually expect great results from the area. Companies and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall immediately start construction programs to uplift the area into greatness. These construction programs include: The establishment of new ports, supply hubs, modernizing and expanding towns and villages, and overall making the area equal to normal standards of the Grand Federation.  

[u][i][b]As usual, Glory to the Federation.[/b]
[/u][/i]

[/spoiler]

[u]End of the Strategic Peace Era; Military Budget Increased to 77 Billion, Tech and Industrial Production Oriented to Military Purposes[/u]

بسم الله العزيز الحكيم 

While the goal of our domestic and foreign policy had been promoting peace and trade above all else, the unfortunate reality is that the world is a dangerous and conflict-driven place. For a few years now, we have been increasing our munitions production and stockpiles and getting our special forces experience in fighting terrorist and criminal groups around the world. However, we still maintained a doctrine that aggressive action could only be done if 

1) We had hard evidence that the only thing that could end a genocide would be military intervention 

2) If Muslims were being violently oppressed and prevented from practicing their religion or 

3) If peaceful dais (people doing dawah, kind of like Islamic missionaries) from our nation were arrested or killed in a foreign country simply for spreading the word of Islam peacefully and respectfully.

Now, however, with more potential threats to our sovereignty and the sovereignty of our friends and allies in the Shamats, we have expanded our doctrine to legitimize a preemptive strike on military forces, bases, or similar targets IF 

1) A neutral or unfriendly nation is massing their forces on our border and we have intelligence that strongly indicates they are planning an imminent attack (as in, the attack is only weeks away), 

2) A nation is hosting known and internationally recognized criminal and/or terrorist groups, and we tell them this and ask them to expel these groups or fight against them with us and they refuse, 

3) Indigenous Shamatine sovereignty is being violated by colonial or neocolonial forces and they refuse to peacefully give up their occupation. 

Along with this, we have mobilized our forces and are able to call up 3 million reserve troops for any possible conflict that may occur. While we currently have 5 major industrial parks that produce munitions, vehicles, equipment, and weapons for our military, consisting of 20 factories and assembly plants in total, as of today we are putting 20 more factories into military production and raising our military budget before the originally scheduled date of November 11. 

We still desire to remain peaceful so long as that is practical and reasonable. However, the Shamats are always seeing some sort of new tensions, and we are no longer willing and able to sit back and let aggressors and occupiers get away with their crimes while our calls for peace fall on deaf ears. In shaa Allah we will not have to implement our new doctrine any time soon, but we will see. 

We do not wish to meet our enemies in battle, but are ready to achieve one of the two greatest things: victory or martyrdom. 

[i]Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi and Incoming Sultan Hassan al-Badawi

Defense Minister Musa al-Yahudiyyah

Foreign Minister Abdoul Mahonomayi[/i][/spoiler]
